title: Baked Fish with Tunisian Flair
description: A Mediterranean-inspired Italian dish that combines the freshness of fish with the rich flavors of the Tunisian tagine.

ingredients.name: Tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Italian or Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Rinse the fish fillets and pat dry with paper towels.
Mix together the tagine spice blend, lemon zest, garlic, and parsley.
Brush the olive oil on both sides of the fish fillets.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Place the fish fillets on the prepared baking sheet.
Drizzle the rich fish broth over the fish fillets.
Sprinkle the tagine spice mixture evenly over the fish fillets.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
